verdict.rationale: dlt has explicit first-party documentation on incremental loading that loads only new/changed records via cursor fields, merge_key/primary_key dedup and upsert, contrasted directly against full reloads, plus built-in state management. This is a core, well-documented feature directly matching the story. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of incremental cursor behavior in production (community evidence only covers schema evolution and general sentiment, not incremental sync specifically), and no evidence of edge-case handling like backfills or state store failures.
